sources.scope: Accepted SDK options and programmatic settings object flow only; initialize itself can probe auth and was not executed

limitations: Trusted approval/classification remains daemon responsibility; wrappers and deserialization do not detect arbitrary secrets or confer authority.
Selected native parsing, approval, materialization and actual session runtime loading are different evidence dimensions; core binding is pending integration.
Private directories and file backend selection are not proof of native account or OS isolation.
Mutable runtime-state contents are excluded from configuration hashing; unknown native inheritance still blocks strict requests.
Codex still mixes some native state/auth with CODEX_HOME; no authentication directory is imported and a reused namespace with unlisted files may fail launch verification.
Claude SettingsManager can inspect native/project sources before SDK options; private config/settingSources=[] requests are not proof all inheritance is excluded.
Qoder native MCP/Skill materialization is unsupported because a published verified settings schema was unavailable.
Native-connected mode remains read-only, no silent ownership switch.
No actual Provider executable, model, account, login command or MCP server was invoked; macOS native tests unrun.
Full configuration UI/transactions/reload/capability runtime evidence remain broader unfinished goal scope.
materializer_revision: agentbaton-managed-runtime-v1; bound with pinned provider contract hashes in logical plan digest
